sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-agent infrastructure dominates today's chart: code review, security auditing, browser control, research workflows, and knowledge-work plugins occupy the top tier. The clearest single spike is cloudflare/security-audit-skill at +3,607 stars, followed by alibaba/open-code-review at +3,286.

sections.title: alibaba/open-code-review
sections.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool with deterministic pipelines and LLM agents.

sections.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
sections.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings.

sections.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
sections.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

sections.title: Tencent/BrowserSkill
sections.description: Lets AI agents use a real, logged-in browser through a CLI and extension.

sections.title: alphaXiv/OpenResearch
sections.description: Turns coding agents into research agents.

sections.title: anthropics/claude-code
sections.description: Agentic coding tool for the terminal, with codebase understanding and git workflows.

sections.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
sections.description: Open-source plugins for knowledge workers using Claude Cowork.

sections.title: Tencent/WeKnora
sections.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform combining RAG, autonomous reasoning, and a self-maintaining Wiki.

sections.title: abue-ammar/tinycast
sections.description: Native macOS launcher with hotkeys and clipboard history.

sections.title: jamiepine/voicebox
sections.description: Open-source AI voice studio for cloning, dictation, and creation.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: AI-agent tooling is the dominant cluster. Languages in the 12 entries: Go: 3, TypeScript: 3, JavaScript: 2, Java: 1, Python: 1, Rust: 1, Swift: 1.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The notable shift is from standalone AI applications toward agent capabilities and operational tooling: skills, harnesses, browser access, security verification, and research workflows. Established infrastructure and security projects remain present, but the highest gains are concentrated in agent-oriented repositories.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's list suggests GitHub attention is moving up the AI stack. Developers are not only adopting coding agents; they are building the surrounding control plane—auditing, browser interaction, memory/knowledge workflows, and reproducible skills—while local voice and inference projects broaden the application layer.
